openings.claim: Removable lateral abutments could resist sliding without increased corner compression associated with opposite-corner lift: transfer sideways reaction from seal friction to two rubber-padded, bolted external-rim strip assemblies bearing against hatch edges.
openings.discriminator: Lateral restraint predicts displacement toward 1 mm under 20 N without increased corner pressure; compression/friction rival predicts improvement only with greater pressure, potentially opposite-corner lift. Proposed, unobserved. Defeat: abutment slip, rotation beyond 1 mm, disturbed closure failure, seal tears, or hardware clearance exceeding 30 seconds.
openings.probe: Check external rim access, bolt reach and clearance using supplied parts/ruler. Use four strips, drilling only strips; overlapping retainers must swivel completely clear and detachable hardware be cord-tethered/recoverable. No powered mechanism or drilling/cutting/gluing/permanent deformation of hatch/trough; preserve existing hatch/rim/seal and unobstructed marked opening. Stop fabrication if secure attachment requires fixture alteration. If viable, run two untreated closure/pull trials, one disturbed, then ten assembly opening/closure/pull cycles, final closure disturbed with 1 mm card at marked right contact. Record marked displacement, opposite-corner lift, reopening time, new visible seal tears; compare supplied untreated 4 mm displacement.
openings.uncertainty: External rim geometry, strip/bolt grip without permanent deformation/obstruction, strip stiffness, pad friction, edge capacity at 20 N and reproducible clamp adjustment are unknown. Ninety-minute fabrication, twelve trials within twenty minutes and one-technician retainer clearance within thirty seconds are assumptions. Clamp slip leaves load-carrier failure versus insufficient capacity unresolved.

lineage.reason: Retains causal carrier change, rival, comparison, defeat conditions, resource/stopping caveats and explicitly uncertain fit.

decision: Retain one feasibility-gated probe. Require position within 1 mm after ten cycles, 20 N resistance, reopening within thirty seconds and no new seal tears, including disturbance except seal-contact continuity. Compression rival lacks dedicated configuration; corner lift can challenge it without establishing full performance. Twelve-trial cap does not establish feasibility. Synthetic model artifact; no deployment or measured improvement claimed.
